Jenna (People Ops): Quick note 1: new Eng Manager Maya starts Mon. I put together a compact Day0-Day4 preflight — posting here for sign-offs and owners.

Sam (Hiring Manager): Need Maya to have read-only prod, billing view for RED-ENG-01, and join infra channels. Approving hardware.

Alex (IT): Laptop order IT-5421 submitted. Need Mayas corporate email and preferred laptop model. Will enroll device in MDM and add to Okta groups once provided.

Priya (Eng Lead): Please add Maya to `team-dataflow` on GH and give commit to infra repo. Also request staging KMS read for her. I'll be buddy for first 2 weeks.

Jenna (People Ops): Adding expense card, parking pass, payroll paperwork, and buddy assignment. I'll draft a one-pager 30/60/90 and share before EOD Friday.

Sam (Hiring Manager): Also please prepare 5 example evals (latency/cost dashboards) for her first week.

Alex (IT): Quick provisioning checklist I'll follow:
``
- Enroll in MDM
- Install standard tools (Chrome, VSCode, Docker, gcloud)
- Add SSH key to GitHub; recommend ed25519
- Add to eng-managers-readonly-prod Okta group
- Submit KMS read request (IT-5422)
```

onboard-bot: I will create Day0/Day1 calendar blocks after accounts are ready: HR + security + team intro.

Priya (Eng Lead): Proposed Day1 agenda: 09:30 team intros, 10:30 architecture overview, 13:30 infra tour, 15:00 1:1 w/ Sam. I'll prep slides and an infra walkthrough.

Jenna (People Ops): Action items:
- Sam: confirmed approvals (prod readonly + billing)
- Alex: complete IT-5421 & IT-5422
- Priya: Day1 slides + infra tour
- Jenna: 30/60/90 one-pager + share Day0 calendar

Sam (Hiring Manager): All good. I'll send Maya a short welcome note and link to the onboarding folder. :tada:
